steps.what: Instruct employees and observe their practice during on-the-job training

tasks.design: Retain practical instruction and observed workplace feedback. Current procedures in {DOCS} support the supervisor; producing a lesson or recording attendance does not substitute for watching safe practice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Custody skills need demonstration and feedback in context.
tasks.enabler_now: Administrative tools do not remove observed instruction.
tasks.still_hard: An employee may repeat instructions correctly but act unsafely under pressure.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises unsafe practice and adapts coaching immediately.

evidence.claim: Retaining observed on-the-job instruction is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is direct instruction, excluding course authoring, qualification administration and the learner's labour.
No structured competent flag or automatic certification is presumed.
Existing guidance remains; no custom tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow change is introduced.
unknowns: Required trainer qualifications and observed competence standards
research_questions: Which practical errors recur despite written instruction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; practical demonstration and feedback retain their full time.

steps.what: Hear inmates, assess immediate safety and resolve interpersonal problems proportionately

tasks.design: Keep listening, de-escalation and proportionate conflict resolution with the supervisor. Existing rules in {DOCS} guide the encounter; no automated account scoring or behavioural verdict is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Accounts, fear and power differences need personal assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Text tools do not replace trust or immediate safety judgement.
tasks.still_hard: An apparent agreement can conceal intimidation or an unresolved threat.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor notices coercion and adapts the response to the people involved.
tasks.altitude: Conflict-resolution time and accountability stay unchanged.

reach.task: Escalate a conflict with underlying welfare concerns

evidence.claim: Retaining inmate conflict resolution is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is direct resolution, excluding incident-report production and general operational supervision; overlapping encounters count once.
No free structured intent or threat label is assumed.
Existing procedures remain; no custom conflict tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because the process does not change.
research_questions: Which apparent resolutions require welfare follow-up?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; listening, safety assessment and resolution remain fully counted.

steps.what: Confirm employee availability, qualifications, required posts and scheduling constraints
Arrange employee shifts against coverage and working-time constraints
Check feasibility, resolve exceptions and approve the final employee work schedule for publication

tasks.design: Configure a constraint scheduler in {HCM} using supervisor-confirmed coverage and staff inputs. It proposes assignments and exposes infeasibility; the supervisor resolves contextual exceptions and approves the exact roster before publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual shift arrangement repeats constraint checks across many combinations.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scheduling software supports hard and soft constraints with planner control.
tasks.still_hard: Unrecorded limitations and sudden absences can make a technically valid schedule impractical.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor judges safe deployment and discusses difficult assignments.

ambition.what: Compare two feasible cover arrangements before planned leave periods

tasks.altitude: Spend less time arranging shifts and more time resolving coverage weaknesses; staffing authority does not expand.

reach.task: Compare coverage alternatives under approved constraints
reach.learn: Constraint feasibility and fair scheduling review

evidence.claim: ORTEC Workforce generates schedules using labour-law and collective-agreement constraints while planners retain final control.
The proposed effort split and savings are E1 scenarios from model knowledge, not measured correctional scheduling results.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's roster preparation, not staff availability submission, personnel record maintenance or officers' worked shifts.

Supervisor s1 captures and verifies employee ID, available intervals, qualification validity, required post and shift, minimum headcount, rest limits, rule version and approved preferences. All capture and correction time remains in its 35 hours; missing or disputed fields stop scheduling for manual arrangement.
Staff and personnel administrators produce availability and qualification records through existing duties; additional rule maintenance is costed below. Test native constraints before custom code.
No automatic publication or staff evaluation. Confirm applicable national consultation and working-time rules before rollout.
unknowns: Native scheduler availability, source completeness and approved coverage rules
research_questions: Can historical rosters be reconstructed without unresolved or unsafe assignments, including all input correction and review time?

already_counted.description: Exception handling and final roster approval

incremental.description: Constraint testing and scheduling exception upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Final roster version with employee IDs, posts, shift intervals and exception resolutions; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R55 gross45 minus6 focal upkeep gives net39. E1 scenario: partial constraint coverage or more manual exception work reduces net return to10-30; existing scheduler runtime is not labour.

tasks.short: Examine inmate mail for regulatory conformance

steps.what: Examine incoming or outgoing mail under applicable regulations and escalate uncertain conformance

tasks.design: Retain authorised examination of physical mail and human interpretation of the rules. Current guidance in {DOCS} supports handling protected correspondence; no automatic content verdict or opening instruction is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical items and protected correspondence need contextual handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Text classification does not establish lawful mail examination or reliable physical inspection.
tasks.still_hard: A sender label alone may not establish whether correspondence is protected.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises uncertainty and seeks authoritative clarification.
tasks.altitude: Mail-examination time and decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Retaining contextual and physical mail examination is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is examination and conformance judgement, excluding transport, unrelated search work and later reports.
No free structured protected-mail or contraband flag is assumed; current policy owners supply existing rules for human interpretation.
Use existing procedures; no custom mail screening system proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; national requirements need confirmation.
unknowns: Local authorisation and protected correspondence procedures
research_questions: Which mail categories require specialist review before any examination?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; physical examination and conformance judgement keep full time.
